fields.statement: Change set 'Stop using CI as a debugger' serves no intent yet, and the daemon builds only change sets that serve a milestone. Which should it serve? (milestone-25 is 'the backlog is empty: the daemon builds and ships on its own'; its sibling 'Ship-change fixes red PR CI' served it.) / When does Rhiza count a repo's CI as unstable (which turns on the full local gate before each push and shows red in rhiza health)? / What is the 'full local gate' a ship-change run runs before pushing while CI is unstable? / When rhiza ship check sees a red PR that passes on its one rerun (a flake), what happens to the run and the flaky test?
